List catalog tables.

## Synopsis

```text
.sqltables [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Lists the tables of the catalog database.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `catalog=` | resource | from [`.catalogs`](../dot-catalogs/) |  |  | Catalog name. |

## Examples

The tables of the public schema in alphabetical order:

```text
.sqltables
```

The tables of the catalog MyCatalog:

```text
.sqltables catalog=MyCatalog
```
